title: Portal navigation usability study
description: Two short tasks using a fictional account portal. This demonstration uses fabricated account information only.
welcome: You will complete two short activities in a sample account portal. Please approach each task as you normally would. The prototype uses fictional information.
consent: I understand that this study will record click locations, navigation, task timing, and the survey answers I provide. It will not record my keystrokes, passwords, or screen video. I will not enter real personal or financial information.

preQuestions.text: How often do you use online account portals?

tasks.title: Locate account activity
tasks.instructions: Imagine you want to review your recent account activity. Use the portal to find the details of the most recent activity entry. Stop when you reach its details.

questions.text: Overall, how difficult or easy was this task?
How clear were the task instructions?

tasks.title: Find a message
tasks.instructions: You received an important message in your account. Find and open the message titled “Account update.” Stop when you can see its contents.

questions.text: Overall, how difficult or easy was this task?
What would you change to make this easier?

postQuestions.text: How satisfied are you with this portal overall?
Is there anything else you would like to share?
